_comment: Hand-authored effects (master plan Phase 12), built from art already in the pack. Each plays when its trigger happens: a behaviour state starting ('state:<name>'), bones changing ('bones_gained', 'bones_spent') or a dumbbell lift paying ('xp_gained'). 'at' is where it starts: 'character_head' (above Caramelo), 'character' (his feet) or 'bone_counter' (the HUD). Sizes and distances are design pixels; 'text' may use {level}, {amount} and {form}. The golden, stone and cosmic form overlays wait for art (plan §13).
